text:
Alex P: FYI ran a 6h canary of zenith13b-int4 on canary-pool-3, we saw ~18 OOMs (cudaMalloc failures) and high mem frag after long convo sequences. attaching quick logs below.

Cheng Li: can you paste the exact error? frag vs leak matters.

Alex P: logs: ```
[2026-03-20T02:11:04Z] RuntimeError: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
[2026-03-20T02:11:04Z] kv_cache_alloc: requested 256MB but only 12MB free (fragmented)
```

Tara S: looks like aggressive prefetch + large max_new_tokens are blowing the working set. What's the current default on this model?

Alex P: currently using profile: `max_new_tokens=1024`, `batch_size=8`, `prefetch_blocks=3`, `kv_prefetch=true` (int4 profile).

Cheng Li: proposal: reduce `max_new_tokens` default to 512 for zenith13b-int4 and set `batch_size=6` for canary. Also enable kv_trim_on_split and lower prefetch_blocks to 1 for now. That should reduce peak allocation pressure.

Ravi K: +1 for lowering prefetch. Also suggest enabling our fragmentation mitigator for that model - `mem_compact_on_evict=true` patch I pushed to canary runtime yesterday. It compacts free list when fragmentation hits threshold.

Alex P: testing Cheng/Ravi suggestions now. rolling change to canary config:```json
{ "model": "zenith13b-int4", "runtime_profile": { "max_new_tokens": 512, "batch_size": 6, "prefetch_blocks": 1, "kv_prefetch": true, "kv_trim_on_split": true, "mem_compact_on_evict": true } }
```

ops-bot: deploy 2498765432 applied to canary-pool-3 (rolling). :rocket:

Cheng Li: also run a quick quant-quality regression on a 1000-sample eval set — lowering max_new_tokens shouldn't affect quality but int4 paths sometimes regress on long-context tasks. Tag the eval run and compare perplexity + pass@k.

Alex P: started eval job `eval/zenith13b-int4/2498765432` — samples include long-form summarization and code completion. Will post results in ~30m.

Tara S: if fragmentation persists, we should try a soft cap on concurrent long-window sessions: route >512 tokens requests to a higher-memory variant (zenith13b-int8-dedicated) as fallback. Might be heavier cost but keeps service stable.

Alex P: quick interim results: after deploy, within 45m we saw OOMs drop from 18 -> 2 (both triggered by synthetic tests hitting 1500 token streams), p50 latency +8% but throughput steady. memory fragmentation metric (free_chunk_ratio) improved from 0.22 -> 0.48.

Cheng Li: nice. Can you capture a flamegraph or GPU memory histogram? want to see if KV cache is the main culprit vs activation buffers.

Alex P: attaching snippet of our memory histogram sample: ```
GPU0: total=40GB used=34.1GB free=5.9GB fragmented=2.7GB
kv_cache: 12.8GB
activations: 18.3GB
allocator_free_chunks: 136 (avg size 20MB)
```

Ravi K: that allocator_free_chunks avg size indicates many mid-sized holes — mem_compact_on_evict should help over time but we may need a background compaction run during low traffic windows. I'll schedule a 03:00 UTC compaction job for canary pool.

Tara S: action items:
- Alex: keep canary config for 24h, collect OOM/latency/cost deltas and post final summary.
- Cheng: run the 1k-sample eval and compare int4 vs baseline.
- Ravi: schedule background compaction and monitor allocator metrics.
- Ops: set routing fallback for >512 token requests to zenith13b-int8-dedicated with a 10% slowdown SLA.

Alex P: ack. early numbers look promising. thanks all. :thumbsup:

Cheng Li: if int4 eval shows regression >1.5% on rouge/code-exactness we revert max_new_tokens for online traffic but keep other mitigations.

Alex P: will post final summary in ~24h with numbers (OOMs, p50/p95, cost per 1k tokens).

Tara S: thanks — feel free to ping infra if the compaction job needs manual intervention. :slightly_smiling_face:
